name: Question 6
problem: Find all of the solutions to $2{x}^{3}-9{x}^{2}+20x-8=0$ given that $x=2-2\text{i}$ is a solution.
worked_solution:
First, we let $f(x)=2{x}^{3}-9{x}^{2}+20x-8.$ 

Since $f(x)$ has real coefficients and ${x}_{1}=2-2\text{i}$ is a root of $f(x),$ the complex conjugate 

$$
\overset{―}{{x}_{1}}=\overset{―}{2-2\text{i}}=2+2\text{i}
$$

must also be a root of $f(x).$

Now, according to the factor theorem, 
$(x-(2-2\text{i}))(x-(2+2\text{i}))$
is a factor of $f(x).$ Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-(2-2\text{i}))(x-(2+2\text{i})) & = \\ {x}^{2}-(2-2\text{i}+2+2\text{i})x+(2-2\text{i})(2+2\text{i}) & = \\ {x}^{2}-4x+({2}^{2}-(2\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ {x}^{2}-4x+8 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we find the quotient when $f(x)$ is divided by ${x}^{2}-4x+8$ using polynomial division.

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,\,2x-1 \\  & {x}^{2}-4x+8\,\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,2{x}^{3}-9{x}^{2}+20x-8\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{3}-8{x}^{2}+16x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,-{x}^{2}+4x-8 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,{-\,{x}^{2}+4x-8}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,0\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, $f(x)=({x}^{2}-4x+8)(2x-1).$ 

To find the remaining root, we set the linear factor equal to zero and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2x-1=0\,⟹\,x=\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the roots are $x=\frac{1}{2},2\pm 2\text{i}.$

Question 6
?

Find all of the solutions to 2x3−9x2+20x−8=0 given that x=2−2i is a solution.

a
x=−14,2±2i
b
x=18,2±2i
c
x=12,2±2i
d
x=±18,2−2i
e
x=−14,12,2−2i
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we let f(x)=2x3−9x2+20x−8.

Since f(x) has real coefficients and x1=2−2i is a root of f(x), the complex conjugate

x1―=2−2i―=2+2i must also be a root of f(x).

Now, according to the factor theorem, (x−(2−2i))(x−(2+2i)) is a factor of f(x). Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

(x−(2−2i))(x−(2+2i))=x2−(2−2i+2+2i)x+(2−2i)(2+2i)=x2−4x+(22−(2i)2)=x2−4x+8.

Next, we find the quotient when f(x) is divided by x2−4x+8 using polynomial division.

x2−4x+82x−1x2−4x+82x3−9x2+20x−8x2−4x+82x3−8x2+16x―x2−4x+82x3−0x2+04x−8x2−4x+82x3−0x2+04x−8―x2−4x+82x3−9x2+20x−0

Thus, f(x)=(x2−4x+8)(2x−1).

To find the remaining root, we set the linear factor equal to zero and solve for x:

2x−1=0⟹x=12.

Therefore, the roots are x=12,2±2i.
